2.q: cells expressing EsCBL10b had the greatest growth on media with salt, while cells expressing EsCBL10a had the weakest growth relative to cells expressing AtCBL10. This result suggests that EsCBL10b strongly activates the SOS pathway while EsCBL10a does so only weakly.
Cross-species complementation assays demonstrated that EsCBL10b has an enhanced ability to activate the SOS pathway while EsCBL10a has a function not performed by AtCBL10 or EsCBL10b.
